name: template-registry
body: Template registry: hold the project's loaded templates (kind by directory: slides/ or sections/), run the load-time checks (cycles, directory-kind checks, cross-kind name uniqueness, reserved names, references — including theme CSS references: relative theme `url()`/`@import`, the reserved `media:` prefix resolving under the library's `media/`, and the reserved `theme:<name>/` prefix resolving under another theme, theme-media-references — and examples), own the central layout function set (v1: `media`), look up templates, describe them for CLI/gallery.
